acceptanceCriteria: one parser owns Playwright JSON report decoding, or a recorded decision justifies each remaining one
existing tests for all three consumers pass unchanged
a shared fixture test proves identical suite/spec/result attribution across consumers
body: Three packages parse Playwright JSON reports independently: internal/appflows, jstestprovider.ParsePlaywrightJSON and internal/playwrightruns. Consolidation was left as a follow-up in docs/build-log/2026-10-11-playwright-run-evidence.md (#801). Divergent parsers risk divergent attribution of suites, retries and outcomes.
title: Consolidate the Playwright JSON report parsers (appflows, jstestprovider.ParsePlaywrightJSON, playwrightruns)
